gloss: high prices; rising cost of living

definitions.gloss: high prices; rising cost of living
definitions.explanation: A situation in which the general price level is high or climbing, so that everyday goods cost more. Common in news reports on the economy and household budgets.

examples.japanese: {物価高|ぶっかだか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
{物価高|ぶっかだか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦|くる}しく→苦しい：02636_kurushii⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Life has become harder because of rising prices.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{物価高|ぶっかだか}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The government announced measures against rising prices.

examples.japanese: {物価高|ぶっかだか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{外食|がいしょく}→外食：03024_gaishoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}える→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Because of high prices, more people are cutting back on eating out.

- {物価高|ぶっかだか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: prices stay high
- {物価高|ぶっかだか}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: measures against rising prices
- {物価高|ぶっかだか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しむ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧: to struggle with high prices
- {物価高|ぶっかだか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧: the effect of high prices
